title: Building a practice in partnership with PortmanDentex
html:
Discover how PortmanDentex’s partnership pathways help ambitious clinicians in building a thriving practice and realising their long-term vision with expert group support.

For ambitious clinicians, building a successful practice is about more than bricks and mortar. It’s about creating a place where clinical vision can thrive, developing a strong team and culture, and shaping a future they can be proud of. PortmanDentex’s partnership pathways are designed to give clinicians greater ownership and influence, alongside the support, investment and expertise of a wider dental group.

What partnership routes are available?

The partnership pathways are designed to suit different ambitions and stages of a clinician’s career. They include:

  • Joint Venture Partner – creating the opportunity to establish and grow a brand new practice alongside PortmanDentex
  • Shared Ownership Programme – this enables clinicians to invest in an established practice, build equity value and share in its future success.

Each pathway is designed to support clinical leadership and give clinicians the support they need to build sustainable practices and deliver high-quality patient care. As a partnership, both parties are committed to the long-term success of the practice.

Hear from the partners themselves

Varinder and Navneet Jhaj became Joint Venture Partners in the newly established SK Dental Clinic, Stockport, creating an exciting platform for growth. Together with PortmanDentex they’re investing in the practice through rebranding, marketing, operational improvements and future expansion, demonstrating how local entrepreneurial leadership can be combined with group support.

They say: ‘Personally, we feel incredibly grateful and honoured to have taken this step into partnership. We are thankful for the trust that PortmanDentex has placed in us, and this partnership gives us the opportunity and platform to bring our vision to life – providing the high-quality dentistry we’re passionate about while continuing to deliver the very best care for our patients. We are excited about what the future holds and the positive impact this will have on our team, our practice, and the community we serve.’

At Clearly Orthodontics in Leicester, specialist orthodontist Maha Aljefri and her husband Haider Alaasam became PortmanDentex’s first shared ownership partners. Their investment reflects their commitment to the long-term future of the practice while allowing them to share in the value they help create.

What are the benefits for clinicians?

For many clinicians, partnership represents the opportunity to combine clinical excellence with business ownership, without feeling they have to do everything alone.

Benefits include:

  • Building equity value and sharing in the success created through long-term growth
  • Greater influence over the direction, culture and future of the practice
  • The freedom to focus on delivering exceptional patient care while being supported by experienced business professionals
  • Access to operational expertise, procurement, technology, finance, marketing and people support
  • The confidence of partnering with one of the UK’s largest dental groups while maintaining the individuality of the local practice
  • Collaboration with a wider network of experienced clinicians and partners.

Ultimately, the partnership model gives clinicians the opportunity to shape and build the future of their practice, with the scale, investment and expertise of PortmanDentex behind them.

If you’re interested in partnership with PortmanDentex, email acquisitions@portmandental.co.uk or visit its website.
